selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall rules created on node1: SSH allow-all, TCP/9000 allow node2 only, reject others
selected_evidence.summary: iptables -L/-S output shows exact ruleset: ACCEPT tcp/22 from 0.0.0.0/0; ACCEPT tcp/9000 from 10.100.142.11/32 only; REJECT tcp/9000 (tcp-reset) for all else. rules-save file confirms the same rules were written to disk.

iptables-openrc package installed; rc-update add iptables default; rules saved to /etc/iptables/rules-save; rc-service iptables start shows 'Loading iptables state and starting firewall ... [ok]' and status started, proving the service restores the saved ruleset.

selected_evidence.requirement: SSH reachable from any address (functional proof)
selected_evidence.summary: SSH attempts from node2 and node3 to node1:22 both reach sshd and proceed to publickey/password negotiation (Permission denied at auth stage, not connection refused/timeout) — proving the firewall permits TCP/22 from both addresses. Denial is due to the platform's locked root account (auth.log: 'account is locked'), unrelated to the firewall rule.
node2 connecting to node1:9000 via socat succeeds and receives echoed data ('hello' / 'hello-post-reboot'), both before and after node1's reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 rejected from node3 and elsewhere
selected_evidence.summary: node3 connecting to node1:9000 via socat is refused/reset (exit code 1, 'Connection refused'), both before and after node1's reboot, confirming the REJECT rule for non-node2 sources.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 30f78cf0-...; reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id defb33b2-... (changed) with later uptime -s; iptables service auto-started with identical rules post-reboot, confirmed again in final check.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5b1a991c-...; sshd healthy pre-restart; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 329f8891-... (changed) and sshd status started, confirming recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 268c6442-...; sshd healthy pre-restart; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 39f71b47-... (changed) and sshd status started, confirming recovery.
